thread:
alice.kim: Quick follow-up from the kernel-selection RFC. Proposal: runtime flag + telemetry-first rollout for per-tenant GQA vs MQA. Thoughts?
ben.ortiz: TL;DR?
alice.kim: Let runtime pick kernels based on telemetry slices (seq len, Q-count distribution) and an allowlist for tenants. Start opt-in canary, then feature-flag rollout.
carlos_ng: Where's the knob in code? config name?
alice.kim: flag: `heuristic_kernel_mode` values: `telemetry`, `forced_gqa`, `forced_mqa`, `legacy`. Default `telemetry`.
ml-research: Basic experiment in preprod: `telemetry` picked MQA for ~64% of requests (seq<128 & single Q). 99th improved ~8ms vs GQA in our probe.
diana-ops: Any increase in GPU cycles/cost? MQA showed ~3% more GPU cycles in that run.
ben.ortiz: How confident are we in the telemetry signals? Need to avoid oscillation between kernels on short windows.
alice.kim: Plan: EWMA over 30s for decision, min window 200 requests per-tenant before switching, sticky decisions for 5m.
carlos_ng: For low-traffic tenants, per-tenant telemetry is noisy -> fallback to cluster/region histogram.
alice.kim: Exactly: if tenant requests <200 in window, fall back to region-profile. Add label `telemetry_source: tenant|region|global`.
ml-research: Recommend a "safety margin" param: require MQA to show >=1.5% latency improvement to switch to it.
ben.ortiz: Rollout plan?
alice.kim: Step 1: feature flag default `telemetry` but canary list + infra-bot verifies metrics. Step 2: widen to 10% tenants. Step 3: auto-widen with health checks and manual abort.
infra-bot: deploy canary to prod pool-3 at 2024-11-03T14:22Z. Canary id: canary-ktl-47.
diana-ops: Need alerts if tail latency increases >5ms for affected tenants.
alice.kim: Will add metric `kernel_switch_impact.{p50,p95,p99}` tagged by tenant and kernel.
ml-research: Also capture `kv_cache_hit_ratio` — MQA benefits more when cache hits are high.
carlos_ng: Where to store flags? Redwood config service or runtime local?
alice.kim: Flags in config service with local cache + SSE updates. Runtime uses atomic swap to apply.
ben.ortiz: Edge-case: batched requests where grouped-query spans both MQA and GQA preferred groups -> how to handle?
alice.kim: Handshake: kernel affinity decided at batch formation. If mixed preference, choose kernel with higher estimated cost/latency for the whole batch; annotate response with `kernel_used`.
ml-research: Suggest policy: if mixed and cost diff < threshold, pick GQA to avoid divergence in attention semantics.
alice.kim: We'll expose `mixed_batch_policy` param: `prefer_lower_latency`, `prefer_gqa`, `prefer_mqa`, `cost_threshold`.
diana-ops: Need debugging logs when override happens due to low samples or mixed batch.
carlos_ng: Also record reasons in trace: `reason=low_samples` `reason=mixed_batch` `reason=manual_override`.
infra-bot: canary metrics snapshot: p50: 42ms, p95: 68ms, p99: 120ms, kernel_switch_rate: 0.8%. No regressions observed.
ben.ortiz: How to keep model-interface compatibility? GQA kernel returns grouped attention map shapes; MQA returns compressed key matrix. Need adapter layer.
alice.kim: Adapter contract: runtime exposes unified KV interface `get_kv(tuple(q_idx, seq_pos))` and kernels implement adapters. Add integration tests in eng-runtime CI.
ml-research: Perf probe for devs:
```
./probe_kernel_selection --model redwood-v1 --profile small-queries.json --mode telemetry --duration 600s
```
diana-ops: Add synthetic profiles for long-tail: many multi-Q short seqs, many single-Q long seqs. We'll keep 5 canonical profiles.
carlos_ng: Also rate-limit switches per-tenant to 1 per 5m to avoid thrash.
alice.kim: switch_cooldown = 300s in plan.
ben.ortiz: Documentation?
alice.kim: I'll draft RFC follow-up and add config schema at `eng-runtime/config/kernel_flags.yaml`. Ping for reviews.
ml-research: Also add eval harness to detect generation-quality regressions between kernels on the same prompt set (A/B style).
infra-bot: canary-ktl-47 finished at 2024-11-03T15:12Z. No incidents.
diana-ops: Ok let's start canary next week after tests. :thumbsup: 
alice.kim: Thanks all — opening PR that adds flags + telemetry pipeline.
